summary:
Knowledgeable and skilled Technical Leader has a keen ability for software development and supervision. Incorporates corporate objectives for project plans and releases. Brings a Master’s degree in Computer Application along with 14 years of experience on java platform working for large organizations.
My major technical skill set includes Java8, Java21, Servlet, JSP, Struts2, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Hibernate with JPA, Restful Web Services, Microservices, JDBC, Maven, JSON, Angular2, Ajax, JavaScript, JQuery, GitHub, SonarLint, Aspera API, Denodo, AWS, Kafka. Knowledge of Generative AI. I have used Google Gemini AI API i.e. Vertex Rest API, Palm Rest API using LLM (Large Language Modal). Understanding of Apache Open Natural Language Processing (NLP). Apart from sound technical skills, I have a good expertise in team management skills, estimation, and project planning using Agile Software Development. I have strong analytical and communication skills. The major responsibilities included as below:
Setting up coding standards and best practices for development and deployment.
Rich experience on project development from scratch to end.
Code reviews and peer reviews as per the initial architectural designs.
Project architectural/control flow review.
Rich experience in MVC based open-source frameworks like Spring Framework, Spring MVC, and Spring Boot.
Experience in Component Based framework Angular2.
Experience in Devops tools for version control and deployment automation.
Client interaction on daily basis to share development status and queries if any.
